chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn Bilal al-Muhalabi reported to me, he said: Ali ibn Abdillah al-Isfahani narrated to us, he said: Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi narrated to us, he said: Muhammad ibn Ali reported to me, he said: Ibrahim ibn Harasah narrated to us, he said: Ja'far ibn Ziyad al-Ahmar narrated to us, from Zaid ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them both) who said:

He recited: \"And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the town, and there was beneath it a treasure belonging to them, and their father was a righteous man. So your Lord willed that they should attain their maturity and bring forth their treasure.\"

Then he said: \"Their Lord guarded them because of their father's righteousness. So who is more worthy of the best protection than us? The Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family, is our grandfather; and his daughter, the leading lady of the women of Paradise, is our mother; and the first one who believed in God, affirmed His oneness, and prayed is our father.\"

key_terms.سيدة نساء الجنة: Leading lady of the women of Paradise; a well-known title of Fatimah al-Zahra (AS)
key_terms.صالحا: Righteous, virtuous; the quality of the father that earned divine protection for his children
key_terms.كنز: Treasure; here referring to a hidden wealth that God protected for the orphans

ai.seo_question: What did Zaid ibn Ali say about Ahl al-Bayt and divine protection in the Quran?
ai.summary: Zaid ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn (AS), grandson of Imam Husayn (AS), recited verse 18:82 of the Quran about how God protected the treasure of two orphans because their father was righteous. He then argued by analogy (a fortiori): if God protects the descendants of a righteous man, then the descendants of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), Fatimah al-Zahra (the leading lady of Paradise), and Imam Ali (the first believer) are even more deserving of divine protection. This hadith was part of the discourse supporting the special spiritual status of Ahl al-Bayt.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 9. He said: Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn Bilal al-Mahlabi reported to me from ‘Ali ibn Abdillah al-Ishfahani, who reported from Ibrahim b Muhammad al-Thaqafi, who reported from Muhammad ibn ‘Ali, who reported from Ibrahim ibn Harasah, who reported from Ja’far ibn Ziyad al-Ahmar, who reported that Zaid ibn al-Husayn, peace be upon him,

once read the verse: ’And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the town and there was beneath it a treasure belonging to them; and their father was a righteous man. So your Sustainer (i.e. Allah) willed that they should attain their maturity and bring forth their treasure....’ (al-Kahf, 18: 82)

Then he said: "Allah guarded their treasure because of their father’s righteousness; so who is worthier for the best protection than us? The messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his progeny, is our grandfather and his daughter, the leading lady of the women of Paradise, is our mother. And the first one to confirm his faith in Allah, His Oneness, and to offer prayers to Him was our father."
